Ukulahlekelwa okuhlanzekile: ayikho intela kulokhu kuthengisa. Ukulahlekelwa ngaphansi kwe-§ 23 EStG kunciphisa kuphela inzuzo evela ekuthengiseni komuntu siqu – ngonyaka ofanayo noma ngokubuyisela onyakeni odlule nokudlulisela eminyakeni ezayo (§ 23 para. 3 ne-§ 10d EStG). Memezela ukulahlekelwa esimemezelweni sakho sentela ukuze kuhlolwe.
Kusukela ku-%1$s lonke inani liyabalwa (umkhawulo wokukhululwa – hhayi isibonelelo).

Imikhawulo isebenza kukho konke ukuthengisa komuntu siqu noma izinsiza zonyaka ndawonye – kufaka nokungaphandle kwe-app.

Okokuqondisa kuphela: isetha indlela, unyaka wentela nesifinyezo sephepha lokusebenza lentela. Ikhadi le-Portfolio lihlala lingachemile – izipho nezimali zokudlulisa zingehluka ephepheni lokusebenza.

Isilinganiso esinyakazayo nge-coin ngayinye ne-wallet – hhayi kuwo wonke ama-wallet (KryptowährungsVO § 2). Imivuzo ingena ezimpahleni ezintsha ngezindleko zokuthola ezingu-0 (BMF: staking / airdrops) – ifayela lemali engenayo liyibhala ngenani ngesikhathi sokwamukela. Izimali ezikhokhwayo azisuseki ezimpahleni ezitholwe kusukela ngo-1 Mar 2021 (§ 27a(4) no. 2, § 20(2) EStG): izindleko nemali etholiwe ngaphandle kwezimali ezikhokhwayo. Inzalo yokuboleka (uhlobo oluvela ekungeniseni kwe-CSV noma enothini) iyimali engenayo ngesikhathi sokwamukela ngamaphesenti angu-27.5 futhi igcina lelo nani njengezindleko zokuthola.

I-staking ngama-coin osuvele unawo nama-airdrop: inani ngesikhathi sokwamukela alibalulekile entelweni – ngokomthetho izindleko zokuthola zingu-0 (§ 27b Abs. 2 EStG; BMF “Kryptowährungen”). Intela isebenza kuphela uma uthengisa.

Ukuthengisa nezimali ezikhokhwe nge-crypto kungukulahlwa – ama-swap ayahlehliswa. Imali ekhokhwayo ye-crypto ekuthengiseni ibalwa entengweni ngaphambi kwezimali ezikhokhwayo – uma kungenjalo kungukulahlwa kwayo ngokwayo ngenani layo. Inani le-portfolio kusukela ezintengweni zokuvala zosuku – uma intengo yokuvala ingekho izindleko zihlala zingenalutho.

Imali yenethiwekhi ekhokhwe nge-crypto (ukudlulisa ku-wallet yakho, ukukhipha) kungukulahlwa kwama-coin emali ekhokhwayo ngenani lemakethe – inzuzo noma ukulahlekelwa kulawo ma-coin kuphela, hhayi ukulahlekelwa kwayo yonke imali ekhokhwayo (%1$s). Ngaphandle kwentengo ebhaliwe: intengo yokuvala yosuku (UTC) yosuku olufanayo; ngaphandle kwentengo yokuvala imali etholiwe ihlala ingenalutho.
Isipho esimakwe ngokuthi “kumlingani womshado / umlingani osemthethweni” asinanzuzo futhi asinakulahlekelwa: imali etholiwe = izindleko zakho zokuthenga, umlingani wakho azithathayo (%1$s).

Ukuthengisa i-crypto nge-stablecoin (USDT/USDC/DAI …) oyigcinayo kuyi-crypto-kuya-ku-crypto lapha futhi akukhokhiswa intela – kubhale njenge-swap eya ku-stablecoin. Ukuthengisa ngama-euro kuphela okukhokhiswa intela – u-“Thengisa” ubalwa njengokuthengisa ngama-euro.
Kufana nemali ekhokhwayo ye-USDT noma ekheshi ekudluliseni phakathi kwama-wallet akho: ayengezwa ezindlekweni zokuthenga futhi ibhalwa njengolwazi kuphela.
Ukufanisa ngokwe-HMRC: usuku olufanayo → izinsuku ezingu-30 ezilandelayo → Section 104 pool.

Ushintsho 1 Jan 2025 (Rev. Proc. 2024-28 safe harbor): uma iminyaka yangaphambilini yasebenzisa i-FIFO kuwo wonke ama-wallet, ama-lot asele ngomhla ka-31 Dis 2024 aya kuma-wallet aphethe ama-coin – i-wallet enama-coin amadala kakhulu ithola izindleko zokuthenga ezindala kakhulu. Lokhu kwabiwa kungumthetho we-app – kuhlole ngamarekhodi akho.

Kusukela onyakeni wentela ka-2025 i-IRS idinga izindleko zokuthenga nge-wallet noma i-exchange ngayinye (Rev. Proc. 2024-28): ukuthumela kusebenzisa i-FIFO nge-wallet ngayinye kusukela ngo-2025 – eminyakeni yangaphambilini i-FIFO kuwo wonke ama-wallet, noma i-FIFO nge-wallet ngayinye uma leyo kuyindlela yakho yezindleko.

Imali yokukhipha nge-USDT noma ngokheshi akukhona ukulahlekelwa: imali ekhokhwayo ngokheshi akuyona izindleko ezisusekayo, imali ekhokhwayo nge-USDT kungukulahlwa ngenani elilinganayo ngaphandle kwenzuzo – ibhalwa njengolwazi kuphela (%1$s).
kuyabalwa: imali engenayo ngesikhathi sokwamukela ngezinga elikhethekile lamaphesenti angu-27.5 (§ 27b(2) no. 1 EStG / BMF) – ama-coin agcina leli nani njengezindleko zokuthola

Imali etholiwe ngaphambi kwezimali ezikhokhwayo ngaphezu komkhawulo wokubika (£50,000; 2020/21–2022/23: £49,200): bika ku-HMRC uma ubhalisile ku-Self Assessment, ngisho ngaphandle kwenzuzo ekhokhiswa intela
Uhlu lwezintengo lwe-ESTV (ictax.admin.ch) yilo olunegunya. Kuma-coin angekho ohlwini, ngokuvamile kusebenza intengo yokuvala ye-exchange. Intela yengcebo ayibalwanga.
Amakheli abukwayo awakwazanga ukufundwa – amabhalansi awo awekho kuleli fayela
Ama-lot amakheli abukwayo abalwa kusukela osukwini lwawo lokuthenga; uma ibhalansi yekheli namuhla iphansi, ayancishiswa.
Amakheli abukwayo abalwa enanini eliphelele kodwa awanazo izindleko zokuthola – ngakho inzuzo kungenzeka iphezulu kakhulu. Bhala izindleko njengokuthenga.

Inani licabanga ukuthi imivuzo yakhokhiswa intela njengemali engenayo ngesikhathi itholwa (inani ngesikhathi sokwamukela ezindlekweni zokuthola) – uma kungenjalo izindleko zokuthola ezingu-0 kungaba ukufunda okuqaphelayo.
Amanani emakethe angenayo intengo ebhaliwe (izimali ezikhokhwayo, izipho/izinkokhelo, ama-swap, imivuzo, izimali zenethiwekhi, inani le-portfolio) ngentengo yokuvala yosuku (UTC) yosuku lomsebenzi
